blockers.detail: Owned council-beta routing queue is empty. Assist Bus reports four active council-beta helper slots, but the connector response truncates before those request objects, so requestId/inputSignature/exactQuestion cannot be lawfully identified without guessing.
blockers.nextLawfulEvidencePath: Read the council-beta helper request objects from a non-truncated Assist Bus projection or helper-specific routing surface, then inspect each referenced packet/evidence and produce only the bounded requested support.

learning.strategy: Did not infer assist targets from ticker memory or unrelated queue entries; preserved root-owner authority and avoided duplicate or mis-scoped work.
learning.successDefinition: A future run should identify active council-beta requests by exact requestId/inputSignature and either add materially new bounded evidence or skip unchanged dormant inputs.
